source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide when an electrical situation is unsafe to handle.

mx.teacher_note: Touching any switch is unsafe, even with dry hands during normal use.

intelligence.enrichment: Electricity can be dangerous if it is not handled carefully, and the human body conducts electricity; current through the body may cause severe injury or death. unsafe contact with electrical supply or wet switches and plugs -> current can pass through the body -> injury risk The learner correctly applies this rule: Electricity can be dangerous if it is not handled carefully, and the human body conducts electricity; current through the body may cause severe injury or death. Briefly touching household switches or plugs is safe if the person is careful.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Electricity: circuits and cells. The student must decide: Decide when an electrical situation is unsafe to handle. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE.
